facts.fact: IGN FI reports the official launch on 27 July 2026 of the Land Administration and Registration Information System (LARIS) project in Zanzibar, with aerial mapping starting to provide the foundation for Zanzibar's Digital Land Information System, funded by BPI and CRDB Bank.
facts.system: Land Administration and Registration Information System (LARIS)

systems.system: Land Administration and Registration Information System (LARIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Lands and Housing Development, Zanzibar

facts.fact: LARIS, an integrated land information system being built by IGN FI for Zanzibar over June 2026 to May 2028, will bring together land ownership, surveying, urban planning, registration and land-use information, per its coordinator.

A journal study of 350 respondents in Dar es Salaam City Council finds the Integrated Land Management Information System (ILMIS) has reduced land disputes and transaction times where fully implemented.
The journal study says ILMIS is integrated with other government functions such as tax administration.
